title: NRC UAP records - Klukan_Oct_2015_Emails_re_Pilgrim_Drone_Spotting
doc_notes: This document consists of an email thread between NRC staff regarding a reported drone sighting at the Pilgrim Nuclear Power Station in September 2015.

incidents.summary: An unidentified object was spotted near the Pilgrim Nuclear Power Station, prompting an investigation by local police and state police.
incidents.explanation: The object was indiscernible at distance; authorities speculated it might have been a weather balloon.
incidents.quote: They think it might have been a weather balloon of some sort, but no one was definite. They are calling it a UFO.
